summary: Answer strict reverse RFI/Submittal-to-Email relationship questions from exact current project evidence.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptable file-grounded support across RFI, Submittal and Email
The complete workflow index already maps one workflow item to all Email members
The forward relationship path provides a reusable exact current-Email citation boundary
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal use the reverse shortcut.
Every returned Email requires one exact current header/body quotation.
Quoted history, signatures, filenames, vision narration, more than eight Emails and more than 32 current passages per Email fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer applicability, chronology, contractual effect or authority.
